class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, width=512, blocks=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.inp = nn.Linear(51 + 54 + 64, width)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(width) for _ in range(blocks)])
        self.t_mlp = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(64, width), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(width, width * blocks * 2))
        self.out = nn.Linear(width, 51)
        self.blocks_n = blocks

    def forward(self, x, t, c):
        h = torch.cat([x, c, sinusoidal(t)], dim=1)
        h = self.inp(h)
        tb = self.t_mlp(sinusoidal(t)).chunk(self.blocks_n * 2, dim=1)
        for i, blk in enumerate(self.blocks):
            s = tb[2 * i]
            b = tb[2 * i + 1]
            h = blk(h * (1 + s) + b)
        return self.out(h)
